title.full: Benefits of the new healthcare licensing framework

summary.text: The HCSA uses service-based licensing, like the UK and Malaysia. It gives licensees more flexibility.

details.heading: How the frameworks differ
details.body: The previous PHMCA framework was based on premises. The new HCSA framework is based on services.

details.heading: Main benefit
details.body: Licensees can provide a range of services and take on new licences in a modular way.

details.heading: Similar countries
details.body: The United Kingdom and Malaysia use similar healthcare systems.

quotes.text: The PHMCA was premises-based whereas the HCSA adopts a service-based licensing structure. This is similar to the healthcare systems in the United Kingdom (UK) and Malaysia.
The PHMCA was premises-based whereas the HCSA adopts a service-based licensing structure.
